caseName: California Manufacturers Ass'n v. Industrial Welfare Commission
caseNameFull: California Manufacturers Assn. v. Industrial Welfare Commission of California and San Joaquin Nisei Farmers League v. Industrial Welfare Commission of California

opinions.text: Sup. Ct. Cal. The order entered by Justice Rehnquist on September 26, 1980, staying the issuance of a peremptory writ of mandate is vacated, and applications are denied.
